name: Iceland — Golden Circle, South Coast & Snæfellsnes

stops.name: Keflavík Airport
stops.notes: Land 6:05 AM after the overnight flight from Boston; pick up the rental car at 7:00 AM, then drive in and drop bags.

stops.name: Hallgrímskirkja
stops.notes: Tower elevator for the view over the city. The interior doubles as an indoor fallback if it's rough out.

stops.name: Reykjavik
stops.notes: Staying with a friend. Keep it light — no driving pressure, room for a nap. Walking loop once up for it: Skólavörðustígur (Rainbow Street) to Laugavegur, old harbor, Sun Voyager sculpture. Nothing today is time-locked.

extras.name: Skólavörðustígur (Rainbow Street)
extras.notes: Walking loop: down Rainbow Street to Laugavegur.

extras.name: Laugavegur
extras.notes: Coffee and browsing.

extras.name: Sun Voyager (Sólfar)
extras.photo: 1990 zum 200-jährigen Jubiläum von Reykjavik wurde die Skulptur Solfar (Sonnenfahrt) enthüllt. 01.jpg

extras.name: Harpa Concert Hall
extras.notes: If energy allows.

extras.name: Tjörnin
extras.notes: City pond, if energy allows.

extras.name: Perlan Museum & Öskjuhlíð forest
extras.notes: Museum + Öskjuhlíð forest walk (WWII bunker ruins, planetarium, artificial ice cave exhibit) — a good jet-lag-friendly half day, and Perlan's exhibits are an indoor fallback if it's rough out. (Aurora) Öskjuhlíð hill is the walkable, elevated viewing spot without a car.

extras.name: Grandi harbour district & Saga Museum
extras.notes: Saga Museum, breweries.

extras.name: Grótta Lighthouse
extras.notes: (Aurora) Reykjavik's best-known viewing spot, ocean-facing, ~15 min drive. Any Reykjavik night (Days 1, 2, 6, 7).

extras.name: Heiðmörk
extras.notes: (Aurora) Darker than the city, ~25–30 min drive. Any Reykjavik night (Days 1, 2, 6, 7).

stops.name: Þingvellir
stops.notes: Rift valley, tectonic plates (~1–1.5 hrs). Parking 1,000 ISK/car (CheckIt app or machine). Visitor center has indoor exhibits if it's a washout.

stops.name: Geysir
stops.notes: Geothermal area; Strokkur erupts every few minutes (~1–1.5 hrs). Parking 1,000 ISK/car (Parka app). Holds up fine in rain.

stops.name: Gullfoss
stops.notes: Waterfall (~30–45 min). Free parking. Holds up fine in rain.

stops.name: Kerið
stops.notes: Crater lake — back in. 600 ISK/person entry (on-site kiosk). If running behind, push to Day 6 instead.

stops.name: Reykjavik
stops.notes: Clockwise loop: ~3.5–4 hrs pure driving, 6–10 hrs with stops. Parking/entry total roughly 2,500–3,500 ISK depending on optionals. Back by mid-to-late afternoon or early evening — room for a Laugardalur pool soak or dinner downtown.

extras.name: Þórufoss
extras.notes: Quick stop: small waterfall en route to Þingvellir.

extras.name: Brúarfoss
extras.notes: Optional detour: smaller, bluer waterfall.

extras.name: Faxi
extras.notes: Quick stop: waterfall, quieter than Gullfoss. Parking ~750 ISK (Parka app).

extras.name: Laugardalslaug
extras.notes: Evening pool soak in Laugardalur — cheaper and more local than Sky Lagoon or Blue Lagoon. Botanical garden and a small zoo next door.

stops.name: Dyrhólaey
stops.notes: Coastal promontory, arch rock. Keep if on schedule, cut first if running late (moves to Day 6). (Aurora) Good viewing spot from Vík on Day 5 night — dark, open sky with the arch as a backdrop.

stops.name: Reynisfjara
stops.notes: Black sand beach, basalt columns — stay well back from the waves. Keep if on schedule, cut first if running late (moves to Day 6). (Aurora) Good viewing spot from Vík on Day 5 night — dark, open sky with the sea stacks as a backdrop.

stops.name: Fjaðrárgljúfur
stops.notes: Canyon, ~1 hr round-trip walk. Locked in — not repeated on the way back.

stops.name: Kirkjugólf
stops.notes: Basalt 'church floor' just outside Kirkjubæjarklaustur. Locked in — not repeated on the way back.

stops.name: Skyrhúsið Guesthouse, Hali
stops.notes: Heaviest driving day of the trip: leaving 8:00 AM, ~9–9.5 hrs door to door (driving ~5.5–6 hrs + stops ~3–3.5 hrs), arriving around 5:30–6:00 PM. Night 1 away from Reykjavik.

extras.name: Víkurkirkja
extras.notes: Church above Vík. Cut first if running late, along with Dyrhólaey and Reynisfjara.

extras.name: Systrafoss
extras.notes: If Reynisfjara is closed for high waves: sub in Kirkjugólf + Systrafoss.

stops.name: Jökulsárlón
stops.notes: Glacier lagoon + Diamond Beach. (Aurora) 13 km from the Hali guesthouse on Day 3 night — one of Iceland's most photographed aurora spots, icebergs reflecting the lights.

stops.name: Skaftafell
stops.notes: Glacier hike + Katla/Jökulsárlón ice cave tour, 9:45 AM (booked) — anchors the middle of the day (several hours including transport/gear).

stops.name: Fox Hostel, Hrífunes
stops.notes: Night 2 away.

extras.name: Diamond Beach
extras.notes: Ice chunks on black sand, across the road from Jökulsárlón.

extras.name: Fjallsárlón
extras.notes: Quieter glacier lagoon, a quick 30–45 min stop just past Jökulsárlón.

extras.name: Svartifoss
extras.notes: Basalt-column waterfall, ~1–1.5 hrs round-trip hike from the Skaftafell visitor centre.

extras.name: Vatnajökull visitor centre (Skaftafellsstofa)
extras.notes: If the glacier/ice cave tour is weathered out (operators rebook or refund); also the Jökulsárlón boat tour or extra time at Diamond Beach.

extras.name: Eldhraun lava field
extras.notes: Quick stop at the moss-covered lava field.

extras.name: Systrakaffi
extras.notes: Dinner near Hrífunes: casual, open daily noon–9:00 PM. Burgers, pizzas (try the local cheese pizza with jam), vegan options, full bar.

extras.name: Klaustur Restaurant
extras.notes: Dinner near Hrífunes, a step up from casual (in Hotel Klaustur): arctic char raised in water from under the Skaftáreldahraun lava field, and local lamb.

stops.name: Vík Hostel
stops.notes: STORM DAY: strong wind warning + ~56 mm rain, worst 9 AM–2 PM, easing into the night. Leave Hrífunes as early as possible and cross Mýrdalssandur before 8–9 AM — direct drive, no stops. Check road.is before leaving and en route: the Múlakvísl bridge has flood history; if it's closed, turn back and wait. Night 3 away.

extras.name: Icelandic Lava Show
extras.notes: Fixed showtimes — book in advance, arrive 15–20 min early.

extras.name: Katla Visitor Centre (Brydebúð)
extras.notes: Geopark exhibition in Vík's oldest building: geology, Katla history, local maritime museum. No booking; confirm shoulder-season hours.

extras.name: Halldórskaffi
extras.notes: In Bryde's House. Locally owned — cured lamb, pan-fried arctic char; lunch or dinner.

extras.name: Smiðjan Brugghús
extras.notes: Vík's brewery: burgers, ribs, hot wings, craft beer brewed on-site.

days.title: South Coast catch-up, back to Reykjavik

stops.name: Sólheimajökull
stops.notes: Glacier viewpoint, short walk from the parking lot.

stops.name: Skógafoss
stops.notes: Waterfall.

stops.name: Seljalandsfoss
stops.notes: Waterfall you can walk behind.

stops.name: Reykjavik
stops.notes: The main South Coast catch-up day: ~5–6 hrs including stops (driving ~3–3.5 hrs + stops ~2–2.5 hrs).

extras.name: Gljúfrabúi
extras.notes: Hidden waterfall, a short walk from Seljalandsfoss.

extras.name: Kvernufoss
extras.notes: Near Skógafoss, 15–20 min walk in. Low priority.

extras.name: Múlagljúfur
extras.notes: Lesser-known canyon, short walk to the viewpoint.

extras.name: Reynisfjara & Dyrhólaey (second pass)
extras.notes: If Day 3 or Day 5 didn't allow enough time there.

extras.name: Reykjadalur hot river
extras.notes: En route: ~45 min walk in to a warm bathing spot near Hveragerði.

extras.name: Kerið
extras.notes: Fallback slot if it got pushed from Day 2. 600 ISK/person entry.

extras.name: Skógar Museum
extras.notes: Bad weather day: indoor turf houses + folk history.

extras.name: Nauthólsvík Geothermal Beach
extras.notes: Evening: man-made geothermal beach near Öskjuhlíð/Perlan; small fee for a hot pot soak.

extras.name: Viðey Island
extras.notes: Evening: short ferry from the old harbor (if not done on Day 1). Trails, birdlife, Imagine Peace Tower.

extras.name: Hlemmur Mathöll
extras.notes: Evening (or Day 7 evening): food hall for a more local dinner than the main tourist strip.

stops.name: Arnarstapi
stops.notes: Coastal walking path to Hellnar; Gatklettur rock arch.

stops.name: Djúpalónssandur
stops.notes: Black pebble beach, shipwreck remains.

stops.name: Kirkjufell
stops.notes: Headline stop of the day, saved for last; Kirkjufellsfoss alongside it.

stops.name: Reykjavik
stops.notes: Long day, 10–12 hrs round trip, depart by 7–8 AM. Evening: dinner and a short wind-down — optional Sky Lagoon or Laugardalur pool.

extras.name: Borgarnes
extras.notes: Route 1 to Borgarnes (~2 hrs to the peninsula), then Route 54 around.

extras.name: Eldborg crater
extras.notes: En route.

extras.name: Grábrók
extras.notes: Crater, en route.

extras.name: Ytri Tunga
extras.notes: Seal beach (seals not guaranteed).

extras.name: Búðakirkja
extras.notes: The black church.

extras.name: Hellnar
extras.notes: Coastal walking path from Arnarstapi.

extras.name: Gatklettur
extras.notes: Rock arch.

extras.name: Snæfellsjökull National Park visitor centre (Malarrif)
extras.notes: Indoor fallback, along with Arnarstapi's cafes.

extras.name: Skarðsvík Beach
extras.notes: Gold sand beach.

extras.name: Svörtuloft Lighthouse
extras.notes: Gravel road.

extras.name: Kirkjufellsfoss
extras.notes: Waterfall alongside Kirkjufell.

extras.name: Grundarfjörður
extras.notes: Passing through.

extras.name: Stykkishólmur
extras.notes: Passing through.

extras.name: Sky Lagoon
extras.notes: Evening soak.

stops.name: Keflavík Airport
stops.notes: Drop off rental car 2:00 PM. Depart 5:10 PM, arrive Boston 6:50 PM.

extras.name: Blue Lagoon
extras.notes: On the way to the airport. Sells out in advance — not yet booked.

extras.name: Árbær Open Air Museum
extras.notes: Historic buildings and old Reykjavik houses, southeastern part of the city.

extras.name: Esja
extras.notes: Proper half-day hike ~10 km north of the city.
